_comment: Template for onboarding a UK regulated mortgage advice firm. Copy to <firm>.json, replace every CHANGE_ME, then dry-run first: npm run onboard-tenant --workspace=packages/api -- --config src/scripts/onboard/<firm>.json --dry-run

org.name: CHANGE_ME Mortgage Services
org.industry: FCA-regulated residential mortgage advice (purchases, remortgages, product transfers)

scoring._comment: sales_only scores a completed case as one unit once a sale trigger fires (CRM webhook or the manual 'this call is a sale' flag). Use 'everything' instead if the firm wants every call scored on its own.
scoring._comment_journey_window: A mortgage case runs fact find -> recommendation -> completion over weeks or months, so the 30-day default would silently drop the early calls from the case. 120 days suits most firms; raise it for new-build cases, which can run six months or more.
scoring._comment_speaker: mono_diarize + mono_first_speaker suit phone-based advice. Teams/Zoom appointment recordings arrive as video and have their audio extracted on ingest; they are mono mixes, so leave transcription_mode as mono_diarize.

scorecard.name: CHANGE_ME — Mortgage Advice QA (MCOB / Consumer Duty)
scorecard.description: MCOB 4 disclosure and suitability, MCOB 11 affordability and interest-only, MCOB 12 charges, FG21/1 vulnerability and the Consumer Duty outcomes. 34 checkpoints.
